name: io.github.forgemeshlabs/seo-authority-mcp
description: SEO authority, keyword, competitor, content, site-audit, and internal-link tools with optional automatic x402 payments.

environmentVariables.name: SEO_API_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Optional backend override; defaults to https://seo.forgemesh.io.

environmentVariables.name: SEO_X402_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional EVM wallet private key for automatic x402 USDC settlement.

environmentVariables.name: SEO_MAX_PAYMENT_USDC
environmentVariables.description: Maximum automatic payment per tool call; defaults to 0.15 USDC.
